title: Tag accounts (ship-fleet signins --accounts --json, version 1)
description: Printed on stdout by `ship-fleet signins --accounts --json` on the FleetLedger computer: the account each tag's Ships must sign in to each sign-in as (ships.toml [tag.<tag>]), the Ships that have each tag, and the Ships whose tags disagree. Read from ships.toml only: it asks no Ship. Account names only, never a credential. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

signins.description: Every sign-in a tag may name an account for, in FleetLedger's order (its sign-in registry: claude, gcloud, github, then any others).

tags.description: Every tag that names accounts or that a Ship has (defaults.tags counting), by name; with --tag, that one only (none when no Ship has it and it names no accounts).

accounts.description: Sign-in id to the account name its Ships must be signed in as (an email address or a login). A sign-in left out has no expectation from this tag.

ships.description: The Ships with this tag, by name.

conflicts.description: Ships whose tags expect different accounts for one sign-in (so it shows as the wrong account whichever it is signed in as); with --tag, only Ships with that tag.

signinId.description: A sign-in id, as FleetLedger's sign-in registry names it (the built-ins: claude, gcloud, github).
